description: Renovate complements Dependabot (which already handles pip / npm / github-actions ecosystems via .github/dependabot.yml). This config focuses on what Dependabot can't see: SHA-pinned scanner binaries downloaded into the Dockerfile via `curl | sha256sum --check`. See docs/docs/development/rule-source-ingestion.md and the worker scanner-toolchain smoke check for provenance review. Semgrep rules are database-managed, not a bundled fallback.

customManagers.description: Dockerfile-pinned scanner binaries (Bandit / Semgrep / Gitleaks / OSV-Scanner). Each line is `curl ... <fixed-version-URL>` followed by `echo "<sha256>  <path>" | sha256sum --check --strict`. Renovate watches the URL for a new release and bumps both the URL and the SHA in the same PR.

packageRules.description: Group scanner-binary updates for review of upstream versions, pinned digests, and the actual worker scanner-toolchain smoke check.
Major version bumps for scanner binaries deserve manual review — they often change CLI flags or output format, which the wrapper code may need to follow.
